Table 1 in Abramova et al. 2023 (Russian Psychiatric Journal). Extracted using pdfplumber.

Cells reported as Mean±SEM are entered as mean and SEM. SD is computed as SEM*SQRT(n). Cells reported as Median(Q1;Q3) store median/Q1/Q3 and estimate mean as (Q1+Median+Q3)/3 and SD as (Q3−Q1)/1.35 (normal approximation). SE is SD/SQRT(n).
If you prefer a small-sample adjustment (Wan et al.), replace SD with: (Q3−Q1) / (2*NORM.S.INV((0.75*n−0.125)/(n+0.25))).
